meta.title: Nature's Unlikely Partners
meta.topic: Symbiotic relationships in the natural world

scenes.narration: You have probably used the word energy a thousand times today.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans standing in a bright kitchen looking surprised, many small golden tally marks floating around his head [LABEL: 1,000 TIMES]

scenes.narration: You wake up low on it.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans sitting on the edge of a bed in a sunny bedroom, yawning with sleepy half-closed eyes and rubbing one eye, a small empty battery symbol floating above his head

scenes.narration: Your phone is low on it by noon.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans on a sunny street looking worried at a small smartphone with a red low battery symbol, a bright sun high overhead

scenes.narration: But here is a strange question.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans tilting his head thoughtfully with one finger raised, standing on a grassy hill, a big cloud shaped like a question mark in the blue sky

scenes.narration: What is it?
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans looking curiously at a small round golden orb floating above his open palm, in a quiet green meadow

scenes.narration: Not what it does.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans pushing a small wooden cart on a dirt path while shaking his head no with one hand raised, green meadow behind him

scenes.narration: What it actually is.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans crouching and peering through a big magnifying glass at a small round golden orb sitting on a rock, wide curious eyes

scenes.narration: Before we begin, a promise.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans holding one hand up with his little finger raised like making a promise, friendly smile, standing on a grassy hill under a blue sky

scenes.narration: Everything I tell you about real science is real.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans standing proudly beside a neat blue science book and a flask of green liquid on a wooden table outdoors, giving a thumbs up

scenes.narration: But the big idea you are about to meet is not science.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans shrugging with both palms up on a grassy field, a pale purple cloud floating above his head

scenes.narration: It is an original thought experiment, made up for the fun of thinking.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans sitting on a rock with a thoughtful face, a big pale purple thought cloud above him full of small golden arrows and sparkles [LABEL: THOUGHT EXPERIMENT]

scenes.narration: I will always tell you which is which.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans standing at a fork in a dirt path between two wooden signposts pointing different ways, scratching his head

scenes.narration: Real science first.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans standing beside a large open blue science book and a flask on a wooden table outdoors, calm and confident

scenes.narration: Imagination second.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans holding a small pale purple cloud in his hand with sparkles around it, standing in a dreamy green meadow

scenes.narration: So what do scientists say energy is?
scenes.imagePrompt: three stick-figure scientists in white lab coats standing in a row on a grassy hill, each with a small thought cloud holding a golden orb, a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans looking at them curiously

scenes.narration: In physics, it is usually described as the ability to cause change.
scenes.imagePrompt: a gray boulder rolling down a tan dirt path after a push, small dust clouds behind it, a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans standing beside it with his hands out [LABEL: ENERGY = ABILITY TO CAUSE CHANGE]

scenes.narration: To move something.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans pushing a small wooden cart along a tan dirt path, dust puffs behind the wheels

scenes.narration: To heat something.
scenes.imagePrompt: a metal kettle on a small stove with steam rising, a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans holding his hands out to warm them

scenes.narration: To do work.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans lifting a heavy wooden crate onto a stack of crates, sweat drops flying off his head

scenes.narration: It comes in many forms.
scenes.imagePrompt: a long wooden table in a green meadow with a row of five objects: a spinning top, a stretched spring, a gray rock, a candle and a red apple, a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans spreading his arms proudly behind it

scenes.narration: The energy of something moving.
scenes.imagePrompt: a red ball racing along a dirt path with speed lines and dust behind it, a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans watching it go

scenes.narration: The energy stored in a stretched spring, or a rock lifted high.
scenes.imagePrompt: on the left a coiled spring stretched wide, on the right a gray rock sitting on top of a tall stone ledge, a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans standing between them looking up

scenes.narration: Heat.
scenes.imagePrompt: a campfire with orange flames and wavy heat lines rising above it, a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans warming his hands beside it

scenes.narration: Light.
scenes.imagePrompt: a bright smiling sun with straight golden rays shining over green hills, a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans shading his eyes with one hand

scenes.narration: And the chemical energy hiding in your breakfast.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans eating a bowl of cereal at a breakfast table with a red apple and a banana, small golden sparkles rising from the food

scenes.narration: And there is one rule physicists trust above almost everything else.
scenes.imagePrompt: three stick-figure physicists in white lab coats giving thumbs up beside a large stone tablet with one golden arrow carved on it

scenes.narration: Energy is never created or destroyed.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans holding a small golden orb in both hands, a red circle with a diagonal slash over a tiny trash can beside him, grassy field

scenes.narration: It only changes form.
scenes.imagePrompt: a golden orb changing step by step into a small flame and then into a spinning top, connected by curved arrows along a grassy path

scenes.narration: A swinging pendulum trades height for speed, and speed for height, again and again.
scenes.imagePrompt: a big pendulum shown at the top of its swing and at the bottom of its swing, small speed lines at the bottom, a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans watching

scenes.narration: The total never changes.
scenes.imagePrompt: a small see-saw perfectly balanced in a meadow with a golden orb on each end, a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans sitting nearby smiling

scenes.narration: Now here is the strange part.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans leaning in with wide surprised eyes and one finger raised, a big pale golden exclamation cloud above him, on a grassy hill

scenes.narration: The physicist Richard Feynman pointed out that we do not truly know what energy is.
scenes.imagePrompt: an old stick-figure physicist with a big round white head, wild white hair, small round glasses and a white lab coat, standing at a chalkboard on a grassy hill, a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans listening beside him [LABEL: RICHARD FEYNMAN]

scenes.narration: We only know the rule it follows.
scenes.imagePrompt: the old physicist with wild white hair holding a long scroll covered in small golden arrows and shrugging, a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans beside him tilting his head

scenes.narration: He compared it to counting a child's toy blocks.
scenes.imagePrompt: a pile of colorful wooden toy blocks on a patch of grass, a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans holding up one red block with a curious look

scenes.narration: You can count them, and the number always stays the same.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans counting five colorful toy blocks on his fingers, five blocks in a row on the ground in front of him

scenes.narration: But the blocks themselves are never there to point at.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans pointing at empty air above a row of toy blocks with a puzzled face, a faint dotted outline of an invisible object floating there

scenes.narration: Energy is a number that always balances.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans standing happily beside a perfectly level balance scale with a golden orb on one side and colorful blocks on the other, a green checkmark floating above

scenes.narration: You can calculate it, and you can predict with it.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans looking confidently at a simple curved graph line drawn on a chalkboard stand, a small telescope pointing at the sky beside him

scenes.narration: But ask what it is made of, and the answer goes quiet.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans leaning over a deep round stone well and whispering into it, one tiny ripple on the dark water far below

scenes.narration: So what if that quiet answer is hiding something?
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans holding a small closed treasure chest and looking at it sideways with narrowed round eyes, meadow behind him

scenes.narration: What if energy is not a thing we have, but a story about where objects are going?
scenes.imagePrompt: a long dotted golden path across green hills with a ball, a leaf and a teacup travelling along it, a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans pointing along the path with an excited face

scenes.narration: Let us play a game.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans grinning and holding a pair of colorful dice, rubbing his hands together, standing on a grassy hill

scenes.narration: Forget everything you know about energy doing work.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans tapping his head while tiny golden sparks float out of his ears, standing in a green meadow

scenes.narration: Throw it away.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans throwing a small blue science book over his shoulder, the book flying through the air along a dotted arc, green meadow

scenes.narration: We are building a brand new idea from scratch.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans drawing the first small golden arrow with a big pencil on a large blank sheet standing upright, a pile of crumpled paper behind him

scenes.narration: Imagine that every object in the universe has its own secret direction.
scenes.imagePrompt: a gray rock, a green leaf, a white teacup and a sleepy orange cat in a row on a grassy hill, each with its own small golden arrow above it pointing a different way, a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans waving behind them [LABEL: SECRET DIRECTION]

scenes.narration: Not left or right.
scenes.imagePrompt: a wooden signpost with two arrow boards pointing left and right, each board crossed out with a big red X, grassy hill behind it

scenes.narration: Not north or south.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans holding a small compass and looking confused, a big red X over the compass needle

scenes.narration: A direction that belongs only to that object.
scenes.imagePrompt: a single gray rock with one small golden arrow floating above it pointing up and to the right, a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans crouching to look at it closely

scenes.narration: In this imaginary world, energy is not the power to do work.
scenes.imagePrompt: a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans shaking his head with both palms up beside a heavy wooden crate, a small red X floating in the air

scenes.narration: Energy is how far an object can keep travelling along its own direction before it naturally comes to rest.
scenes.imagePrompt: a round ball resting with a sleepy face at the far end of a long dotted golden path stretching across a green hill, a measuring bracket spanning the whole path [LABEL: ENERGY = HOW FAR IT CAN TRAVEL]

scenes.narration: A lot of energy means a long journey ahead.
scenes.imagePrompt: a happy round ball at the start of a very long dotted golden path winding far across hills into the distance

scenes.narration: A little energy means the journey is almost over.
scenes.imagePrompt: a tiny yawning ball at the start of a very short dotted golden path with only three dots and a small finish flag

scenes.narration: But what happens when two objects, each with its own direction, meet?
scenes.imagePrompt: two golden arrows pointing toward each other across a grassy field, a round ball behind each arrow, a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans watching from a small hill

scenes.narration: That is where this idea gets interesting.
scenes.imagePrompt: two big golden arrows facing each other with a small gap between the tips and tiny bright sparks starting to appear in the gap, a stick-figure man in a blue t-shirt and blue jeans leaning forward from a rock, excited
